name: Junon.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Junon.io is a free iogame. Welcome to the void. Deep space. The eternal vacuum. The big black nothing. You're on your spaceship and you're trying to survive. You'll need to gather resources and craft them into more than the sum of their constituent parts. Survival is key. Survival is the goal of this game. You will need to stay alive and more than that, you will need to thrive. This is a survival game with a lot of strategies. It is a real-time game where you are trying to stay alive. This is an iogame based around surviving and thriving. this is a game that will teach you to gather, craft and thrive. make repairs, grow food, and generate oxygen if you want to stay alive. Take off into the gnarly obsidian void of space, the last frontier, the absolute end. Junon.io is a free iogame that will allow you to thrive.
